DIAGNOSTICS - ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM WITH ELECTRONIC D1-309
BRAKE FORCE DISTRIBUTION (EBO}
INSPECTION PROCEDURE
1 Check operation of stop llght. I I
CHECK:
Check that stop light lights up when brake pedal is depressed and turns off when brake pedal is released.
Repair stop light circuit (See page BE-33). B
2 Check voltage between terminal STP (A11 - 5) of ABS ECU and body ground.
PREPARATION:
Remove ABS ECU with connectors still connected.
CHECK:
Measure voltage between terminal A11 - 5 of ABS ECU and
body ground when brake pedal is depressed.
OK:
Voltage: 8 -14 V
T
F071SD
Check and replace ABS ECU. Bl
3 Check for open circuit In harness and connector between ABS ECU and stop
light switch (See page llh'I0).
Repair or replace harness or connector. B
Proceed to next circuit Inspection shown on problem symptoms table (5ee page D1-284).
